name: claude-mem
description: Persistent Context Across Sessions for Every Agent – Captures everything your agent does during sessions, compresses it with AI, and injects relevant context back into future sessions. Works with Claude Code, OpenClaw, Codex, Gemini, Hermes, Copilot, OpenCode + More
one_liner: Gives an AI coding assistant a long-term memory so it remembers your project between chat sessions instead of starting from scratch every time.
buyer: A freelance developer or small dev team billing clients for AI-assisted work who is tired of re-explaining the same codebase context every new session.
business_use_cases: A freelance developer juggling five client codebases installs it so switching projects doesn't mean five rounds of re-explaining architecture.
A small agency standardizes it across the team so every engineer's Claude Code session shares the same compressed project history.
A solo founder uses it to keep a six-month AI-assisted rebuild coherent without manually re-pasting notes every morning.

money_ideas.idea: Hosted 'Pro' memory tier with faster retrieval and larger context budgets (already referenced in the project's own README).
Paid consulting to wire it into a company's specific multi-agent, multi-tool dev setup.

steal_this: Install it on your own project, document the before/after context-loss pain with screenshots, and publish that as content to attract AI-tooling consulting clients.
